name: Bounce
author: Mark Steere (2023) / AGP port
description: Mark Steere's unification game. The board starts as a full checkerboard of red and blue checkers with only the four corners empty. Each turn you teleport one of your checkers to any empty square, but it must land in a strictly larger group than the one it left; with no legal move you must remove one of your own checkers instead. Get all your checkers into a single orthogonally connected group and you win.
